    for source_path in $source_path2

        depths=dav2

        depth_l1_weight_final=1.0
        python train.py \
            --source_path $source_path \
            --model_path $model_path \
            --images $images \
            --depths $depths \
            --test_selection_path $test_selection_path \
            --depth_l1_weight_final $depth_l1_weight_final \
            --resolution 1 \
            --data_device cpu \
            --port 32356
        python render.py \
            --source_path $source_path \
            --model_path $model_path \
            --images $images \
            --depths $depths \
            --test_selection_path $test_selection_path \
            --resolution 1 \
            --data_device cpu \
            --skip_train
        python metrics.py \
            --model_path $model_path \
            --metrics_save_path ${model_dir}/metrics/3dgs-depth-${test_selection}/${scene_name}_metrics.csv
        render_dir=${model_dir}/renders/3dgs-depth-${test_selection}/${scene_name}
        mkdir -p $render_dir
        cp -r ${model_path}/test/ours_30000/renders/* $render_dir/
    done
done

export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=3

model_path_base=/data2/zhangao/outputs/baselines_continuous
model_path_ext=pgsr-original

source_path1=/data2/zhangao/mipnerf360/bicycle
source_path2=/data2/zhangao/mipnerf360/bonsai
source_path3=/data2/zhangao/mipnerf360/counter
source_path4=/data2/zhangao/mipnerf360/flowers
source_path5=/data2/zhangao/mipnerf360/garden
source_path6=/data2/zhangao/mipnerf360/kitchen
source_path7=/data2/zhangao/mipnerf360/room
source_path8=/data2/zhangao/mipnerf360/stump
source_path9=/data2/zhangao/mipnerf360/treehill
max_all_points1=5000000
max_all_points2=1000000
max_all_points3=1000000
max_all_points4=3000000
max_all_points5=4000000
max_all_points6=1500000
max_all_points7=1200000
max_all_points8=4200000
max_all_points9=3300000
for source_path in $source_path1 $source_path2 $source_path3 $source_path4 $source_path5 $source_path6 $source_path7 $source_path8 $source_path9
do
    if [ $source_path == $source_path1 ]; then
        max_all_points=$max_all_points1
    elif [ $source_path == $source_path2 ]; then
        max_all_points=$max_all_points2
    elif [ $source_path == $source_path3 ]; then
        max_all_points=$max_all_points3
    elif [ $source_path == $source_path4 ]; then
        max_all_points=$max_all_points4
    elif [ $source_path == $source_path5 ]; then
        max_all_points=$max_all_points5
    elif [ $source_path == $source_path6 ]; then
        max_all_points=$max_all_points6
    elif [ $source_path == $source_path7 ]; then
        max_all_points=$max_all_points7
    elif [ $source_path == $source_path8 ]; then
        max_all_points=$max_all_points8
    else
        max_all_points=$max_all_points9
    fi
    scene_name=$(basename $source_path)
    echo "Processing scene: $scene_name"
    model_path=${model_path_base}/${scene_name}/${model_path_ext}-${max_all_points}
    images=images_4
    test_selection_path=${source_path}/discontinuous.txt
    python train.py \
        --source_path $source_path \
        --model_path $model_path \
        --images $images \
        --test_selection_path $test_selection_path \
        --max_all_points $max_all_points \
        --opacity_cull_threshold 0.05 \
        --resolution 1 \
        --data_device cpu \
        --port 52345
done
